Title: Command the city
Body: WASD or the left stick pans. Mouse wheel or LT/RT zooms. Q/E or RB/LB rotates. Edge-scroll is on.

Title: Build menu
Body: 1-9 open build categories. Left click places a building. Drag left-click to raise walls; corners and gates snap automatically.

Title: The dead walk
Body: Recruit militia from the military panel (hotkey M). Right-click issues Attack / Guard / Patrol / Retreat. Squads focus-fire and retreat on their own when wounded.

Title: Night falls
Body: Zombies are faster after dark. Solar panels go idle. Keep the medical center powered.

Title: Emergency powers
Body: Curfew, Quarantine, and Martial Law live on the Policies panel. They slow the virus at a morale cost.

Title: Walls and gates
Body: Drag a wall line. Auto-corners appear on turns. Convert a segment to a gate (hotkey G) so squads can pass; gates are weaker.

Title: Research
Body: Open the tech tree (hotkey T). Triage Protocols is the first medical tech; the Vaccine Program is the endgame.

Title: The grid
Body: Districts go dark when generation cannot cover demand. Build a generator or cut a power line to isolate a lost district.

Title: Ammo discipline
Body: Squads hold fire when the stockpile is below the low-ammo threshold. Queue Ammunition at a workshop.

Title: Hunger
Body: Build farms. Hydroponics later boosts yield. Shortages tank morale and then health.

Title: Controller
Body: D-pad selects build categories. A confirms, B cancels, Y opens the command radial, LB/RB rotate, LT/RT zoom. Steam Input remaps everything.
